svg.aria-label: Interference-to-signal ratio of softmax attention against M up to about 2 million pairs, for d = 64, under four rules for the sharpness. With the query equal to the stored key and a fixed sharpness of 8, the interference reaches the signal near 1.2 million pairs; the log-scaled rules fall as M grows.
svg.text: recall fails: more interference than signal
number of stored memories M (key dimension dk = 64)
